long_description:
✨ Celebrating 10 Years of Navratri Together! ✨

Let’s come together as a community once again to celebrate the vibrant festival of Navratri! 🎉💃 This year is extra special as we celebrate our 10th consecutive year of dancing, celebrating, and keeping this beautiful tradition alive together! ❤️🙏🏼

Get ready to hit the dance floor as Boston Desi DJ brings the beats for another unforgettable Navratri celebration! 🎶💃 An evening filled with music, Garba, dancing, friends, community, and endless fun awaits!

✨ More than just dancing!

📸 Take photos at our beautiful photo backdrop

❤️ Mingle with friends and community members

🍽️ Enjoy delicious food (to be purchased, more details to follow)

🎶 Dance the night away to amazing music

🙏🏼 Join us for Puja & Aarti as we celebrate our culture and seek the blessings of Ambe Maa

🎟️ Don’t wait to grab your tickets!

 https://buytickets.at/navratri2026

Early Bird Pricing until September 15th:

Adults (10+): $20

Children (5–10): $15

Children under 5: FREE

After September 15th:

Adults: $25

Children (5–10): $20

Please share with your family & friends! ❤️

The event is OPEN TO ALL TOWNS — EVERYONE IS WELCOME!

We can’t wait to celebrate 10 wonderful years of Navratri with all of you! 💃🎶🎉🙏🏼 

Also check out other Festivals in Lexington.
